chose: Fix the randomizer's phantom document scroll by making the result scroll container position:relative
over: adding position/contain to <main> in the app shell
hand-editing DetailPane so its .sr-only badge spans stop escaping
because: main is overflow-hidden but unpositioned, so absolutely-positioned descendants (Tailwind .sr-only inside RecipeTagStrip badges) resolve their containing block OUTSIDE main and extend the document by ~200-430px. Positioning the randomizer's own scroller is the smallest change that establishes the containing block, it is layout — the one thing §7.2 says the randomizer owns — and it needs neither DetailPane nor the shared shell. Browser-verified: documentElement.scrollHeight 924 to 720 at 1280x720, and equal to clientHeight at 1024x768 and 390x844.

chose: Delete RandomizerBoxResult's lightweight loading card and show a Spinner instead; class survives
over: keeping the card, which copies DetailPane's container, display-title heading, meta row and 4:3 image box verbatim
extracting RecipeDetailHeader from DetailPane per §7.2's trigger
because: §7.2 forbids copying a heading or a meta row out of DetailPane outright, and §7's 'render the lightweight card' collides with it; the absolute clause wins. §7.2's own remedy is the extraction, which is a DetailPane edit and out of this review's scope, so the copy is removed rather than replaced. Measured cost in browser: the placeholder was on screen for under one 60ms sample locally. The class survives — nothing stops the next agent re-adding a second recipe header; only the §7.2 extraction dissolves it.

chose: Spell the skip-recent window one way — days, from a single exported SKIP_RECENT_DAYS constant
over: the spec's verbatim '2 weeks' in the pool line (§4.6/§6.2)
because: the screen shipped saying 'skipping 2 from the last 2 weeks' beside a chip saying 'Skipping the last 14 days' about the same number, with 14 hardcoded in three places and '2 weeks' as a literal that would keep claiming a fortnight after the constant moved. Days is the unit the API stores and the comp's chip uses; the spec's sentence shape is kept, only its unit is dropped.

chose: A set filter chip is painted --accent (butter-pale), via aria-pressed/data-set variants on the outline Button
over: a hand-rolled chip with its own hover/press transforms
because: the roll CTA beside it is crocker red, so a red chip read as the thing to press rather than as a state; --accent is the design system's 'this one is chosen' fill, already used by outline's own hover and aria-expanded and by selectable-row. Keeping variant=outline means the 2px border, hard shadow, hover lift and press sink stay the primitive's. Browser-verified: set chips rgb(255,233,160), CTA rgb(226,35,26).

chose: Report the randomizer_result_action telemetry gap with a recommended one-prop fix; do not edit DetailPane
over: adding the optional prop to DetailPane in this review
re-implementing the four actions in the randomizer so it can capture them
because: four of §9's five randomizer_result_action values fire inside DetailPane's handlers. DetailPane is explicitly outside this review's scope, and §7.2 sanctions exactly one optional prop defaulted to today's behaviour — so the honest move is to name the prop and leave the edit to whoever owns that file.

over: add an invariant or boundary claim that the change does not require
because: Review-and-fix pass on a UI surface. The two behavioural fixes I made are already pinned by contracts that exist: draw.test.ts asserts skipRecentDays === 14 as a literal, which is exactly the guard SKIP_RECENT_DAYS needs (change the constant, the test goes red and someone must justify it); and the empty-draw path now simply does nothing, which removes state rather than adding a rule to assert. The rest — document-scroll containment at three viewports, chip fill tokens, sentence case, aria-label and live-region behaviour — is layout and paint that jsdom cannot measure, so a vitest anchor for them would assert class strings, not the property that actually broke. Those are pinned by the defect records instead (def-00383cb4edaa carries the reproducer: documentElement.scrollHeight vs clientHeight on /household/randomizer), and the honest home for a real guard is a browser-level test harness this repo does not have.
